AnalysisIdentity.description:
Exact immutable analysis inputs; hashes are canonical SHA-256 digests.

Explicit null history_cursor identifies an empty append-only event history.
Omitting the cursor is invalid; callers must bind even the empty state.
AnalysisIdentity.title: AnalysisIdentity

AnalysisPolicy.description: Caller supplies tolerances and margin; no invented engineering defaults.
AnalysisPolicy.title: AnalysisPolicy

BeamDeflection.description: Prismatic Euler-Bernoulli beam; no cardboard shell or buckling inference.
BeamDeflection.title: BeamDeflection

CameraCalibration.description:
Lens model valid only for the stated device at this exact image size.

Stored photos carry no EXIF, so FORMA cannot verify the device; the binding
is the user's statement plus an exact width/height match, uncropped.
CameraCalibration.title: CameraCalibration

CandidateCheck.description: One row of the declared check matrix. Unknown is never a pass.
CandidateCheck.title: CandidateCheck

CandidatePiece.description: A named canonical piece. Names are engine labels, not observations.
CandidatePiece.title: CandidatePiece

CaptureDeclaration.description: What the user states about the scene; a photo cannot establish these.
CaptureDeclaration.title: CaptureDeclaration

ConstructionOperationBinding.description: External operation association; the fabrication adapter must authenticate it.
ConstructionOperationBinding.title: ConstructionOperationBinding

CurrentValue.description: What is saved now. An unconfirmed value is an estimate, never a fact.
CurrentValue.title: CurrentValue

DecisionChange.description: Before/after comparison of two decisions for the same project.
DecisionChange.title: DecisionChange

DecisionThreshold.description: The governing predicate, computed by the compiler or a cited rule.
DecisionThreshold.title: DecisionThreshold

DimensionDomain.description:
A finite step-aligned grid between explicit inclusive bounds.

Values are ``lower_mm + k * step_mm`` for ``k`` in ``0..count-1``. When the
bounds are empty the count is zero and ``empty_reason`` names the limiting
inventory or requirement.
DimensionDomain.title: DimensionDomain

EstimateInput.description: Everything an estimate depends on; its digest identifies the estimate.
EstimateInput.title: EstimateInput

FabricationInput.description: Lineage from the root version to the version being scheduled (last).
FabricationInput.title: FabricationInput

FabricationSnapshot.description: Exact inputs a report was computed from.
FabricationSnapshot.title: FabricationSnapshot

IntakeProposal.description:
The provider's whole answer. Every field is required, so a reply with
only text labels, or with items silently left out, is not accepted.

``items``: each visible object is listed. ``partial``: more objects are
visible than are listed. ``no_objects``: nothing to list, stated
explicitly. An unidentifiable object is an ``uncertain`` item, never left
out.
IntakeProposal.title: IntakeProposal

ItemIdentity.description: What the object probably is. ``uncertain`` never selects a category.
ItemIdentity.title: ItemIdentity

ItemProposal.description: One visible instance proposed by Muse.
ItemProposal.title: ItemProposal

JointDemand.description:
A named, explicitly supplied scalar failure-mode demand and allowable.

The stage adapter authenticates joint membership. A comparison does not solve
load distribution or infer peel, shear, moment and fatigue interaction.
JointDemand.title: JointDemand

MeasurementTarget.description: Exactly what to measure. ``key`` is stable across inventory revisions.
MeasurementTarget.title: MeasurementTarget

MechanicalSnapshot.description:
Mechanical consumer projection, supplied by the canonical pose producer.

This is not a scene/pose producer. Nominal and observed are declarations,
never inferred evidence. Contacts and rigid-body applicability are explicit.
MechanicalSnapshot.title: MechanicalSnapshot

OutlineInput.description: Where the material is. Boxes are refined; a polygon is used as drawn.
OutlineInput.title: OutlineInput

PieceAnnotation.description: User or model naming proposal, never a measurement or an observation.
PieceAnnotation.title: PieceAnnotation

Point3.description: World SI coordinates: right-handed x/y, z upward; never viewer offsets.
Point3.title: Point3

ProposedItem.description: ``ItemProposal`` with the shorter evidence a fresh response may use.
ProposedItem.title: ProposedItem

QuantityEstimate.description:
A scalar, inclusive interval or unknown in an explicit SI unit.

Dependencies and correlation groups preserve shared uncertainty. Provenance is
descriptive, never a calibrated confidence probability or physical test result.
QuantityEstimate.title: QuantityEstimate

RecognizedItem.description: A saved, editable card. ``id`` is stable; ``name`` is the display name.
RecognizedItem.title: RecognizedItem

ReferenceInput.description: What the reference is and how its physical size is known.
ReferenceInput.title: ReferenceInput

RepairPatch.description: Flat parameter edits, not executable operations or arbitrary JSON patches.
RepairPatch.title: RepairPatch

RepairProbeSummary.description: Read-only result of the existing repair simulation for an active build.
RepairProbeSummary.title: RepairProbeSummary

RigidTransform.description: Right-handed local-to-world rotation and translation in metres.
RigidTransform.title: RigidTransform

SavedFact.description: A saved input the decision depends on, for showing what changed.
SavedFact.title: SavedFact

SearchBudget.description: Node budget is deterministic; the time budget is a guard reported apart.
SearchBudget.title: SearchBudget

SearchIdentity.description: Every revision the result depends on; a mismatch makes it stale.
SearchIdentity.title: SearchIdentity

SlidingDemand.description: Single contact's supplied reaction demands, not a reaction-force solver.
SlidingDemand.title: SlidingDemand

stand_includes_all_parts_and_connectors.title: Stand Includes All Parts And Connectors

StabilityOverlay.description: Server-computed modeled geometry only, never physical evidence.
StabilityOverlay.title: StabilityOverlay

StabilityReport.description:
Modeled result only. Physical evidence references confer no physical pass.

Required coverage is the policy's case/check Cartesian product. Additional
cases may be reported, but cannot hide an unresolved required check.
StabilityReport.title: StabilityReport

StandDesign.description: Complete identity of one candidate; every value is checked on the server.
StandDesign.title: StandDesign

statement.default: Spread of results when the stated inputs vary by the stated amounts. It is a sensitivity analysis, not a calibrated confidence interval.
statement.title: Statement

VersionHistory.description:
One plan version and the physical reports recorded against it.

``carried_operation_ids`` and ``base_last_event_id`` are the approved
revision boundary; a root version has neither.
VersionHistory.title: VersionHistory

VisibleBox.description: Approximate, normalised to the photo (0..1). Not a measurement.
VisibleBox.title: VisibleBox
